title: Novel polycaprolactone and polyvinyl alcohol electrospun nanofiber material loaded with antibacterial LEGO-LPPO
text:
1 Analysis Supplement (Pre-publication)
This repository serves as the official supplemental data and analysis report for the manuscript: Novel polycaprolactone and polyvinyl alcohol electrospun nanofiber material loaded with antibacterial LEGO-LPPO”. To maintain the integrity of the peer-review process, the full reproducible R code, raw data, and detailed modeling justifications will be made publicly available here immediately upon the manuscript’s acceptance for publication.
